metadata.title: Cool stars in the Galactic Center as seen by APOGEE: M giants, AGB stars and supergiant stars/candidates

notes: No eligible stars. The high-velocity discussion at T:p9-b2 reports a population exceeding 300 km/s and considers possible origins, but does not identify any individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate or establish that any star satisfies an unbound criterion. The paper’s “candidates” at T:p3-b5 and T:p4-b1 are AGB/supergiant candidates, not Galactic unbound candidates.
